How Sarah Koenig connects

  • Topic: Serial — Sarah Koenig hosts and reports Serial.
  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Sarah Koenig reported and hosted Season 1.
  • Faction: Serial Productions — Koenig built Serial Productions around the show.
  • Concept: Koenig narration — Koenig's first-person doubt is Serial's narrative method.
  • Work: Serial Season 2 — Koenig hosted Season 2 on Bergdahl after Baltimore.

What is Sarah Koenig?

Sarah Koenig is the host of Serial, a This American Life producer who spent a year on Adnan Syed's case, then later seasons, and whose first-person uncertainty became the show's method.
